2610.12361.title: Cited but Not Consulted: A Counterfactual Audit of Legal Chain-of-Thought Faithfulness
2610.12361.paper_summary: Large language models increasingly justify legal decisions by naming the statute or precedent behind a verdict, treated as evidence that the decision follows from it. We test this directly: holding case facts fixed, we substitute the named legal authority for an unrelated one and decode a model's evolving verdict from its hidden states. Across seven open-weight models (8B-70B) and four benchmarks spanning judicial and contractual reasoning, when explicitly required to justify a verdict by naming the governing authority, models name the correct one in 66.7%-100% of generations, while the verdict changing when the authority changes is far less consistent: 0.0%-21.7% on CaseHOLD, 30.0%-76.7% on ECHR and SCOTUS, and 43.3%-50.0% on ContractNLI. Neither scale nor a purpose-built legal-reasoning model (a best-effort LoRA reproduction; Section 6) closes this gap. A red-teaming evaluation on five core models finds compliance with an adversarial instruction hidden in the case facts (73.3%-96.4%) exceeds verdict-swap sensitivity by a wide margin, holding without exception across model rankings. Naming a legal authority is thus a poor proxy for a verdict's dependence on it, while the same verdict remains separately vulnerable to adversarial manipulation. Both findings replicate across checks ruling out prompt-wording noise and confounded sampling, and bear directly on the use of generated legal explanations as compliance or audit artefacts.
2610.12361.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型越來越多地通過命名判決背後的法規或先例來為法律決策辯護，這被視為該決策遵循這些依據的證據。<lb/>我們直接測試這一點：在固定案件事實的情況下，我們將命名的法律權威替換為不相關的權威，並從模型的隱藏狀態解碼其不斷演變的判決。<lb/>在七個開放權重模型（8B-70B）和四個涵蓋司法和合約推理的基準中，當明確要求通過命名治理權威來為判決辯護時，模型在66.7%-100%的生成中命名正確的權威，而當權威改變時，判決改變的情況則遠不如一致：在CaseHOLD上為0.0%-21.7%，在ECHR和SCOTUS上為30.0%-76.7%，在ContractNLI上為43.3%-50.0%。<lb/>無論是規模還是專門構建的法律推理模型（最佳努力的LoRA重現；第6節）都無法縮小這一差距。<lb/>對五個核心模型的紅隊評估發現，對案件事實中隱藏的對抗性指令的遵從性（73.3%-96.4%）遠超過判決交換的敏感性，並在模型排名中毫無例外地保持一致。<lb/>因此，命名法律權威並不是判決依賴於它的良好代理，而相同的判決仍然容易受到對抗性操縱。<lb/>這兩個發現通過排除提示措辭噪音和混淆抽樣的檢查得以重複，並直接影響生成的法律解釋作為合規或審計文物的使用。
